author_decision: 2026-10-17: Test different physical sky heights: house districts at roof height, exterior areas higher for the city walls.
retired_test_policy: 2026-10-17: The author ruled out 6000 simultaneous actors and instructed that this size never be tested again. The final active run was stopped on request; earlier evidence is retained. Current performance comparisons use peaceful scenes and 1000 attackers with 600 defenders.
scope: Isolated diagnostic; normal MAP06 and gameplay data remain unchanged pending measurement and author review.
high_height_policy: Preserve each existing ceiling (1024 MU in the outdoor map).
district_policy: House and shop lots plus half the authored road width. Retained houses use their footprint, authored doorstep and road endpoint plus that same margin. Exclude the perimeter wall-walk belt and any cells whose floor or 3D volume extends above the house roof.
closed_roof_policy: When a selected solid floor reaches the low ceiling, use its existing opaque floor material as ceiling material; open streets retain F_SKY1.
comparison: Fresh opaque-high-wall versus variable-sky repeats; reuse the previously verified normal geometry checkpoint only as qualified historical context.
camera_authority: Existing observer sites0/4; site5 is CaelumCityData.HouseRoad(0), facing along its street. Diagnostic observation coordinates, not gameplay values.
